subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should maintainers split the remaining work into a heartbeat wake precedence bugfix first, or also change Telegram DMs away from the documented default main-session behavior?
rationale: The heartbeat precedence path is a concrete bug, but changing Telegram default DM routing would alter documented compatibility behavior for existing users.

options.title: Split heartbeat precedence first
options.body: Rework or adopt the heartbeat wake fix so explicit `heartbeat.session` wins, while leaving Telegram DM default behavior controlled by `session.dmScope` until a separate decision.

options.title: Bundle Telegram isolation
options.body: Change Telegram DMs to isolate by default as part of this issue, accepting the upgrade and documentation impact for users relying on main-session continuity.

options.title: Defer to heartbeat entries
options.body: Hold this behind native per-session heartbeat scheduling, which may be cleaner long term but leaves the current forced-session contamination path unresolved longer.

recommendation.title: Split heartbeat precedence first
recommendation.body: Rework or adopt the heartbeat wake fix so explicit `heartbeat.session` wins, while leaving Telegram DM default behavior controlled by `session.dmScope` until a separate decision.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent mainline heartbeat/routing maintenance and the compatibility-sensitive decision make this the best available routing owner from the history signals.
